scope: Read-only before and after guest observations
Exact accepted scanner evidence, fresh 70 plus six versions and core services
VM evidence required for explicit unassessed provider microcode limitation
Independent console, idle workloads and downtime/recovery limitations confirmed by operator
Checkpoint persisted before separately confirmed reboot command is copied

No guarantee of zero provider, boot or postcheck findings
